notes.title: 2nd Improvement Update
notes.notes:
Hello, this is IvoryHand.

The 2nd improvement update for Signanota has been applied.
The following changes are included in this update:

Cutscene Sound effects. 
Partial improvement of UI. 
Bug fixes and stability enhancements.

The 3rd update will be released in the near future too with major UI improvements.

We sincerely thank all players for supporting and enjoying Signanota.

notes.title: 1st Improvement Update
notes.notes:
Hello, this is IvoryHand.

The 1st improvement update for Signanota has been applied.
The following changes are included in this update:

* Partial improvement of sound effects and UI
* Bug fixes and stability enhancements

The 2nd update is already in development and will be released in the near future with further improvements.

We sincerely thank all players for supporting and enjoying Signanota.

notes.title: Emergency Update
notes.notes:
A critical bug related to patterns and choices has been discovered, and an emergency patch has been implemented.
We sincerely apologize to all users who experienced inconvenience due to this issue.

To ensure a smoother gameplay experience, please make sure to update to the latest version before playing.

Once again, we offer our deepest apologies.
